title: A complex analytic monic cubic 3-web germ with distinct generic directions, unequal-weight linear symmetry, identically zero normalized Chern connection and the specified commuting lifted idempotents reconstructs a Frobenius 3-fold germ with isotropic unity
author: Sergey I. Agafonov
difficulty_reason: The proof reconstructs an invariant metric and multiplication from multivalued web-root fields, then turns their commutativity and normalized connection equations into a compatible system for an analytic associativity potential. The weight matching and potential reconstruction produce holomorphic Frobenius tensors through the singular web point, a nonlinear geometric inverse construction beyond ordinary qualification differential geometry.
source_version: Official SIGMA 8 (2012) article 078, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2012.078; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.note: Full conditional Theorem2 is selected, not the broader existence wording in the abstract or the singularity classification/experimental examples. Read Definition1-2, full constant-metric form derivation in Section3, all normalized root forms/Chern connection and transformation data, explicit lifted idempotents/orthogonality coefficients with K=-1, the three-equation conversion to the hydrodynamic system(11), complete Lemma1 third-derivative potential/associativity reconstruction, and Theorem2 metric/Euler construction. Standard Dubrovin potential-to-Frobenius correspondence and the earlier booklet/characteristic-web identification are cited published background; the new web-to-potential equations and idempotents are displayed. The Chern form must vanish identically in the stated normalization, not merely be closed or holomorphic, and the explicit lifted e1,e2 must commute. The converse, nonisotropic Theorem3, normal-form families and experimental type1 construction are not counted.

statement_scope: Full Theorem2 under the complex-analytic germ setup: the monic cubic ODE p^3+S(x,y)p^2+A(x,y)p+B(x,y)=0 defines a 3-web with pairwise distinct directions generically. It admits X=w_x x partial_x+w_y y partial_y with w_x!=w_y; the Chern connection form gamma of normalization(5) is identically0. With K=-1, take v_i and alpha,beta exactly as(10), and lifted e1=alpha partial_t+v1,e2=beta partial_t+v2 as(7); require[e1,e2]=0. Then a Frobenius3-fold germ with<e,e>=0 has that booklet web. The author takes metric(3) with delta1, unity partial_t and Euler E=(2w_y-w_x)t partial_t+X. This does not claim that closed/holomorphic Chern form and a symmetry alone imply the conclusion.
editorial_warning: Source annotation only: equation(7) repeats the label e1 on its third displayed idempotent. The preceding sum-to-unity statement(1), the explicit coefficient(1-alpha-beta), and the subsequent orthogonality equations identify that third vector as the e3 used in the construction. Source labels/formulas remain unchanged; the selected assumptions use the separately unambiguous first two lifted fields.
